description: EF Core data-access, multi-tenant and RBAC infrastructure for SQL Server, host-agnostic (HTTP, Blazor Server, background jobs). REQUIRES the MyIdentity package to be configured in the host: even the path without RBAC needs its AddMyIdentity call, because the tenant and the user are resolved through IMyIdentityCurrentUserAccessor. REQUIRES Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer: the guarded-delete helpers detect foreign-key violations through SQL Server error 547 and will not translate constraint errors on any other provider. Exception messages are in Spanish and there is no localization seam. Start at GETSTARTED.md, section 0.
releaseNotes: WHAT CAN BREAK, AND IT IS NOT A SIGNATURE. There is no InfraBase 5.12.0 or 5.13.0: the number follows MyIdentity 5.14.0, the floor of this version. That floor is a decision to align the dependency with the MyIdentity version current when this one closed, and not what the code asks for: the code compiles from MyIdentity 5.13.0, which introduces IMyIdentityModuleScopeValidator, the interface TenantScopeValidator now implements. A direct reference of yours to MyIdentity below 5.14.0 fails the restore with NU1605: raise it in the same change or remove it, after reading sections 56, 57 and 58 of its UPGRADE.md. From 5.14.0 on, InfraBase is published on nuget.org with its symbol package; versions up to 5.11.0 are not there, and a nuget.config whose packageSourceMapping maps InfraBase to another source does not see 5.14.0 until that pattern reaches nuget.org too. The symbol package carries the line numbers of a stack trace, and no longer embeds the sources or a Source Link map. With AddInfraBaseScopeValidator registered, the scope of a role assignment is validated against the space of every module the role grants: a row of a root declared ScopeModule.SelfScoped for that root's modules, a row of TScopeRoot for any other. A role of a self-scoped root's module only takes the root's Id and refuses a unit's; a role that mixes both spaces takes only a tenant-wide assignment, save a number that is a unit and a row of the root at once, which validates and opens both; and MyIdentity asks again on a write of the role's matrix that adds a module. Over a TScopeRoot that declares RowOwner, where every bounded assignment threw, a row of the tenant now validates. The refusals are MyIdentity's ScopeNotValidForRoleModules() and RoleModulesNotValidForAssignedScope(int), in place of ScopeDoesNotBelongToTenant(): translate them if you translate MyIdentity's messages, write a role's matrix before assigning it bounded to a self-scoped root, and review the bounded assignments stored before this version. The collision guard of ScopeModule.SelfScoped compares module codes ignoring case and surrounding spaces, as MyIdentity does, so a model that spells one code two ways is now refused when it is built. ApplyReadScopeBaseAsync(LeaseTicket.None, …) over rows queried in memory now reads the entity's declaration off the model of the service's context type and narrows as with the lease's ticket, where it handed a self-scoped root, an entity declared ScopeModule.Inherit and the root of a TPH hierarchy with a scoped descendant back untouched for every user. The refusal of the tenant-wide question of ReadsEveryOwner carries AuthorizationDeniedCause.ReadsEveryOwnerNeedsTenantWideRead, where it carried Unspecified. WHAT CHANGED BESIDES. SecuredGetService.GetSelfScopedQueryableAsync<TRoot>(moduleCode) reads a self-scoped root from the service of another entity, narrowed on its Id by the scopes the caller reads under that module; the messages of a row of a self-scoped root name the declaration and its way out instead of those of a row with no scope. Nothing is removed. The MyIdentity range is now [5.14.0, 6.0.0), and InfraBase asks no database migration of its own. Read "Upgrade 5.11.0 → 5.14.0" of UPGRADE.md, which lists every change, its test and what to do about it. IF YOU ARE ON 5.11.0, THE PUBLISHED VERSION BEFORE THIS ONE, THAT SECTION IS THE ONLY ONE YOU READ. UPGRADE.md travels inside this package: .nuget/packages/infrabase/5.14.0/UPGRADE.md
